description: This Java source file defines the LauncherShortcuts activity, which handles creating and responding to launcher shortcuts in an Android application. It manages shortcut creation, displays incoming intents, and provides mechanisms to set up shortcuts with specified intents, names, and icons.

classes.name: LauncherShortcuts
classes.description: An Activity that manages creating launcher shortcuts and handling shortcut intents, providing UI feedback and shortcut setup functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, resolves intent action, and either sets up a shortcut or displays intent info.

methods.name: setupShortcut
methods.description: Creates a shortcut intent with specified properties and returns it to the launcher via setResult.
